our_interpretation: Assess the main assertion as a conditional requirement for survival, fulfillment of obligations, or an IPO, rather than merely checking the arithmetic of reported projections.

Use realized calendar-year 2030 revenue against realized calendar-year 2026 revenue. The surrounding annual projections make this a reasonable reading, but 'now' could instead mean a current run rate.
'Effectively 10x' means approximately tenfold, without inventing a precise tolerance.
Survival means continued operation through the horizon. Paying some current bills is not fulfillment of all the obligations invoked.
The attribution to The Information is a separate historical component. Correctly describing projections would not establish the necessity of achieving them.
criteria.support_condition: At least one specified business outcome occurs within the relevant period, revenue grows approximately tenfold on a consistent basis, and evidence establishes that this growth was necessary rather than merely coincident.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A specified business outcome is achieved and the completed 2030 comparison shows revenue materially below tenfold growth. Earlier revenue below the threshold alone cannot refute an end-2030 requirement.
